verdict.rationale: Docusign has AI features, including AI-assisted review and ready-to-deploy agents, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. However, every MCP item in the pack describes Docusign acting as an MCP server that Claude, Gemini CLI or Copilot connect to. That is the opposite role and earns no credit here. Nothing shows Docusign accepting or plugging in third-party MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
